name: rocket-math
description: Local-first Grade-3 math computation fluency trainer (Rocket Math model)

scripts.deploy:cf: vite build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=rocket-math --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:cf:learning: vite build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=rocket-learning --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.test:content: python3 -m unittest discover -s content -p "test_*.py" && python3 content/build_english.py --check && python3 content/build_chinese_reading.py --check
scripts.test:localization: python3 -m unittest discover -s content/localization -p "test_*.py" && python3 content/localization/build_english.py --check && python3 content/localization/verify_english.py --report
scripts.mini: npm run mini:engine && npm run mini:content
